sql: select v.version, g.gate_key, g.kind, g.from_state, g.to_state, g.evidence_started_at, g.superseded_by_gate_id, (select count(*) from experiment_gate_results r where r.gate_id = g.id) as results from experiment_gates g join experiment_versions v on v.id = g.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id where e.key = 'mmsell-price-ceiling' order by v.version, g.gate_key
